title: India’s energy storage market set for breakout year in 2026
content: After a record year for energy storage tenders in 2025, projects awarded since mid-2023 are expected to begin commissioning in 2026, reflecting typical development timelines of 18 to 24 months.

title: Thicker alumunium oxide layers can reduce ultraviolet-induced degradation in TOPCon solar cells
content: UNSW researchers developed an experimentally validated model linking UV-induced degradation in TOPCon solar cells to hydrogen transport, charge trapping, and permanent structural changes in the passivation stack. They show that thicker aluminum oxide layers significantly improve UV resilience by limiting hydrogen migration, offering clear guidance for more robust TOPCon designs.

title: Japanese companies to build world’s largest liquefied hydrogen carrier
content: Kawasaki Heavy Industries and Japan Suiso Energy will construct a 40,000 cubic meter vessel designed to meet global hydrogen demand in the 2030s.

title: Semi-transparent photovoltaics cost-competitive only up to 50% transparency
content: Researchers from Spain found that semi-transparent PV systems are commercially viable only up to about 50% transparency, as higher transparency sharply reduces efficiency and increases system costs. Their analysis shows that declining power density, and not balance-of-system or financing factors, is the main driver of higher LCOE, even in high-irradiation regions.

title: Corrosion-free bromine flow battery promises longer life and higher energy density
content: A new two-electron bromine chemistry sharply cuts corrosion while boosting performance, opening a clearer path for zinc–bromine flow batteries at grid scale.

title: Rising silver prices drive China’s Longi shift to copper-metallized solar cells
content: China’s Longi says it will begin mass production of base-metal PV modules in the second quarter of 2026 as rising silver prices intensify pressure to reduce metallization costs.

title: Germany adds 17.5 GW of solar in 2025
content: Germany installed about 17.5 GW of new PV capacity in 2025, taking cumulative installations past 117 GW by year end, according to preliminary data from the German Solar Association.

title: Spain opens €90 million funding round for 7 GWh of pumped hydro storage
content: Spain will provide €90 million ($105.3 million) in funding for nearly 1 GW of pumped hydro projects, adding 7 GWh of long-duration energy storage (LDES) by 2035. Each project will be eligible for a maximum €50 million grant and all work must be completed by June 30, 2035.

title: US state repurposes wastewater land for 250 MW solar plant
content: Consumers Energy has switched on a 250 MW solar project in western Michigan built on an active municipal wastewater treatment site, using a dedicated 138 kV grid connection.

title: Fox ESS rolls out stackable battery system
content: Chinese manufacturer Fox ESS has launched a 5.99 kWh capacity modular battery energy storage system that can be scaled up to 83.86 kWh per stack.

title: New process achieves 97% silver recovery from end-of-life solar panels
content: Australian researchers have developed a new separation technique that employs the same crushing and flotation principles used in mineral processing to recover more than 97% of silver from end-of-life solar panels.

title: EPFL researchers enhance perovskite solar cell performance via rubidium
content: Researchers led by Michael Grätzel at the Ecole Polytechnique Federale de Lausanne in Switzerland have recently led efforts to improve perovskite optoelectronic properties using small-radius rubidium ion chemistry to enable more stable and efficient perovskite solar cells.

title: ML System unveils solar facade panels, roof-integrated PV tiles
content: The Poland-based module manufacturer has developed Photonwall, a building integrated solution for ventilated façades. It also offers Photonroof, a ceramic PV roof tile solution. Both BIPV products are available in colors and finishes that match the aesthetics of modern and historic buildings.

title: Industrial batteries in France earn revenue through secondary reserve
content: Storio Energy has enabled behind-the-meter (BTM) industrial battery systems to participate in the automatic Frequency Restoration Reserve (aFRR), a service that has until now been dominated by front-of-the-meter storage in France.

title: Mibet releases mounting system for flat-roof PV installations
content: The Chinese company said its novel Z-type mounting supports installation angles of 5°, 10°, and 15° and withstands wind speeds up to 45 m/s. It claims a lifespan of more than 25 years.

title: Singapore forecast to reach 5.3 GW of solar by 2035
content: UK consultants GlobalData say Singapore could add between 300 MW and 400 MW of solar annually through to 2035, taking cumulative capacity from around 1.9 GW today to the 5 GW threshold.

title: New research sheds light on defect regions in perovskite solar films
content: A Chinese research group has demonstrated an electrical imaging technique using 3D tomographic conductive atomic force microscopy to investigate passivation strategies of perovskite films to improve stability and efficiency of perovskite solar cells.

title: Huawei, Sungrow lead Wood Mackenzie’s inverter market ranking
content: Wood Mackenzie’s first-half 2025 solar inverter ranking finds the top 10 leading inverter manufacturers have a 71% global market share.

title: France, Germany, Italy break solar records in December
content: AleaSoft Energy Forecasting's latest analysis finds Germany broke its record for solar production on a day in December on Christmas Day, reaching 87 GWh, while Italy and France achieved the same feat three days later, registering 66 GWh and 54 GWh respectively.

title: Greece struggling to connect grid-scale battery storage projects
content: Greece has awarded permits for about 900 MW of standalone, front-of-the-meter battery storage through three auctions, but no projects have yet been connected to the grid.

title: China strengthens intellectual property protection in solar industry
content: Chinese authorities are planning to implement a series of policy measures to introduce stronger intellectual property protection to the country's photovoltaic sector. Chinese enterprises are being encouraged to accelerate technological advancements and reserve basic patents for developing technologies.

title: California water district plans up to 21 GW of solar on fallowed farmland
content: A California water district has adopted a long-term plan to develop up to 21 GW of solar generation on agricultural land fallowed due to water shortages.

title: Researchers propose new taxonomy for agrivoltaics
content: A Malaysian research team proposed new concepts such as cowvoltaics, sheepvoltaics, goatvoltaics, veggievoltaics, fruitvoltaics and fishvoltaics to better define the diverse applications of photovoltaics in dual land use. Their review outlines four main categories - livestockvoltaics, crop-based agrivoltaics, aquavoltaics, and zoovoltaics - and presents several business cases.

title: Spain allocates funding for 9.4 GWh of large-scale storage projects
content: Spain has awarded more than €818 million ($956.3 million) in European Union funding to 126 energy storage projects totaling 2.2 GW of power and 9.4 GWh of capacity.

title: Australia rooftop solar installs rise as households shift to larger systems
content: Australia’s rooftop solar market climbed by 22% in the past month with the latest data revealing that 334 MW of small-scale PV capacity was installed on household and business roofs across the country in December 2025.
